title: TOB KENJIケンジ - Official Trailer
seoDescription: Tears of Blood – Kenji ケンジ: Raphy Studios’ original animated short film series, coming in the second half of 2026.

description.text: Kenjiケンジ, a promising young martial artist training alongside his father in their home dojo, sees his life turned upside down after an unexpected attack sets him on an unimaginable path.

concept.text1: The project's first explorations were created to depict Haruto's dojo, Kenji's grandfather. It's an environment surrounded by mountains that will play an important role and be explored much further in Part 2 of the project.
concept.text2: Alongside that, we also created several color studies to define the mood of the opening scenes. This particular piece holds a special place for our team. It's one of our favorite explorations and perfectly captures the atmosphere we wanted to achieve.

trailerBanner.title:
TEARS OF BLOOD
FIRST TRAILER
trailerBanner.text1:
This short film was born from a simple conversation between friends
and a shared desire to create something of our own.
trailerBanner.text2:
A first-time director, a screenwriter, and an illustrator came together,
and from that collaboration emerged the biggest project we have
ever had the honor of bringing to life.
trailerBanner.text3: A film made by us, for us.
